summary.text: Qi path true inheritance is the qi path legacy Heavenly Court holds from Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable, the most valuable qi path true inheritance named in that stretch of text.

claims.text: While researching the first half of Primordial Origin’s true inheritance, Fang Yuan treats that segment as Primordial Origin’s qi path true inheritance. It mainly talks about the killer move qi wall, Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable’s signature method, which Duke Long handed over under Fang Yuan’s firm attitude during the Eastern Sea Dragon Palace contest. Fang Yuan also states that Heavenly Court solely held the most valuable qi path true inheritance in the world while qi path had been declining. He researches this qi path true inheritance while his clone works in Beast Calamity grotto-heaven.
Narration notes that without the prior scheme, Fang Yuan would not have obtained a portion of Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable’s qi path true inheritance.
Fang Yuan had already advanced to rank eight and used his Qi Sea Ancestor identity to get a portion of Primordial Origin’s qi path true inheritance out of Duke Long’s hands.
After defeating Zhang Yin, Fang Yuan declares to Eastern Sea immortals that his battle strength rose again because he obtained Primordial Origin’s qi path true inheritance from Heavenly Court.

Heavenly Court recounts that Qi Sea Ancestor changed his mind after Duke Long gave him half of the qi path true inheritance, and that during the fate war Qi Sea Ancestor did not show up, which they treat as proof Duke Long chose wisely.
Heavenly Court Gu Immortals note that with Primordial Origin’s qi path true inheritance they have a huge advantage in qi path and stand at the peak compared to all others.

Fang Yuan recalls spending much thought and effort to scheme for this qi path true inheritance. Duke Long used half of Primordial Origin’s true inheritance to stabilize Qi Sea Ancestor, and after the fate war Qin Ding Ling hands Fang Yuan the remaining half on an information path mortal Gu. In that remaining half, triple qi retraction is recorded. Qin Ding Ling treats Primordial Origin’s true inheritance as bait, knowing Qi Sea Ancestor will still need suitable qi path Immortal Gu from Heavenly Court treasuries to activate the recorded killer moves.

Even though Fang Yuan has the complete Primordial Origin qi path true inheritance, he does not benefit much from it while Qi Sea Ancestor remains only one of his identities and he already holds many rank eight Immortal Gu.

Luck inspection of the Qi Sea clone names many qi path Immortal Gu along with the complete Primordial Origin qi path true inheritance among the reasons for a boundless white qi sea luck, together with over two million qi path dao marks and the Righteous Qi Alliance leadership.
